about.intro: OuWealth Community ni porogaramu yagenewe ibimina n'imiryango y'amafaranga.

service.title: Serivisi
body: OuWealth ni porogaramu y'ibimina: abanyamuryango, imisanzu, inguzanyo, ibihano, ikigega cy'imibereho, ishoramari, kugabana inyungu na raporo. Turi abatanga porogaramu. Ntituri banki, ntituri abatanga inguzanyo kandi ntituri abajyanama mu by'imari.

accounts.title: Konti n’inshingano
body: Bika ibanga ry'uko winjira kandi utange amakuru nyayo. Abaperezida n'abayobozi b'ibimina bashinzwe inyandiko binjiza n'ibyemezo batanga, no gukoresha neza uruhare rwa buri wese.

data.title: Amakuru y'ikimina
body: Ikimina cyawe ni cyo gifite inyandiko zacyo. Ugomba kuba ufite uburenganzira bwo kwinjiza amakuru y'abanyamuryango bawe. Dufata amakuru bwite nk'uko bisobanurwa mu gice cy'Ibanga n'amakuru bwite kiri hasi.

privacy.title: Ibanga n’amakuru bwite
body: Dutunganya amakuru bwite gusa kugira ngo dukoreshe OuWealth. Muri rusange, ni aya:
items: Amakuru ya konti: amazina, izina ry'ukoresha, imeri na nimero ya telefone.
Amakuru y'abanyamuryango: nimero y'indangamuntu n'aderesi aho ikimina cyawe kibibika, itariki yo kwinjira n'imigabane.
Amakuru y'imari y'ikimina: imisanzu, inguzanyo, ibihano, ikigega cy'imibereho, ishoramari, kugabana inyungu n'ibikorwa by'amafaranga.
Dosiye ushyiraho, nk'ibimenyetso by'uko wishyuye, n'amateka y'uko winjiye n'ay'ibikorwa byakozwe.
after: Tuyakoresha mu gutanga no kurinda serivisi, kwereka inyandiko abo ikimina cyawe cyemereye, kohereza ubutumwa bukuri ku kimina cyawe, gucunga ifatabuguzi no gutanga ubufasha.
Kugera ku makuru bishingira ku ruhare: buri munyamuryango abona ibyo uruhare rwe rwemerera, naho abayobozi babyemerewe babona gusa inyandiko z'ikimina cyabo. Ntitugurisha amakuru bwite.

Ushobora gusaba kubona, gukosora, kugabanya imikoreshereze cyangwa gusiba amakuru yawe bwite, kwanga ko amwe mu mikoreshereze yayo ikorwa, no gukoresha ubundi burenganzira bwose bwemewe n'amategeko akurikizwa. Zimwe mu nyandiko z'imari n'iz'igenzura zishobora gukomeza kubikwa.

subscription.title: Ifatabuguzi
body: Ibimina bishya bishobora gutangira n'igihe cy'igerageza kitishyurwa, hanyuma bigakomeza ku ifatabuguzi ry'ukwezi cyangwa iry'umwaka ku giciro kigaragara ku rubuga rwacu. Ifatabuguzi nirirangira, ibikorwa byandika cyangwa bihindura amakuru y'imari bishobora kugabanywa kugeza ryongeye gushyirwaho. Kureba inyandiko no gukuramo raporo biracyakunda.

use.title: Imikoreshereze yemewe
body: Ntukoreshe urubuga mu bikorwa binyuranyije n'amategeko, ntugire undi uha konti yawe, ntushyireho dosiye zangiza, kandi ntugerageze guhungabanya cyangwa kwinjira muri serivisi ku ngufu.

liability.title: Kuboneka n’inshingano
body: Dukora ibishoboka ngo urubuga rukomeze kuboneka kandi rube ruhamye, ariko ntidushobora kwemeza ko rutazigera ruhagarara. Mu rugero amategeko yemera, OuWealth ntiryirengera igihombo kitaziguye cyangwa ibyemezo bifashwe hashingiwe ku nyandiko zinjijwe n'abanyamuryango b'ikimina.

suspension.title: Guhagarika konti

changes.title: Impinduka n’amategeko agenga

entitlements.explain: Uwakira agomba kwakira gusa amafaranga y’uruhererekane yakusanyijwe koko ku kwezi kwe. Imisanzu iteganyijwe si amafaranga ahari, kandi ibyabuze bikomeza kuba ibirarane by’imisanzu: ntibyimurirwa ku wundi. Ubwishyu bukerereye bwongera gusa ibyo uwakira w’ukwezi kwa mbere agomba.

entitlements.unreconciledNote: Amafaranga amwe y’uruhererekane yanditswe binyuze mu nzira za kera nta kwemeza ko yakiriwe. Ari mu gitabo cy’imari nk’amafaranga ahari kandi abikirwa uzayakira, ariko ntiyemerewe gutangwa kugeza yemejwe binyuze mu bwishyu bwemejwe cyangwa mu guhuza kwemejwe (Ubwishyu, igice cyo Guhuza amakuru).

reversal.title: Gusubiza inyuma
reversal.needsAnotherOfficer: Undi muyobozi agomba gufata icyemezo kuri uku gusubiza inyuma. Uwabisabye, uwishyuye n’uwohereje ubwishyu ntibabishobora.
reversal.requestExplain: Nta kintu gihinduka kugeza undi muyobozi yemeje. Kwemeza bisubiza inyuma amafaranga y’ubu bwishyu ku mezi y’imisanzu kandi bigakosora igitabo cy’imari; bihakanwa iyo igihinduka cyakurikiyeho cyangwa ubwishyu bw’uruhererekane bibigira bidahuye.
reversal.reasonLabel: Kuki ubu bwishyu bugomba gusubizwa inyuma?
reversal.declineExplain: Ubwishyu buguma bwanditswe kandi nta kintu gihinduka.
reversal.requested: Gusubiza inyuma byasabwe. Undi muyobozi agomba kubyemeza.
reversal.withdrawTitle: Kuraho icyifuzo cyawe cyo gusubiza inyuma
reversal.withdrawExplain: Nta kintu gihinduka: ubwishyu buguma bwanditswe kandi icyifuzo kirafungwa. Kukuraho byandikwa mu mateka y’ubwishyu.
reversal.needsFundAuthority: Umuyobozi ufite ububasha ku mafaranga (Perezida cyangwa Visi Perezida), utari uwabisabye, ni we wenyine ushobora kwemeza cyangwa kwanga uku gusubiza inyuma.
reversal.loanNote: Gusubiza inyuma bisubiza buri bwishyu bw'inguzanyo ku nguzanyo yabwo (inguzanyo yongera kugira umwenda yari yishyuye, ibice by'ubwishyu bigafungurwa, kandi inyandiko z'imari zigasubizwa inyuma) kandi bisubiza inyuma amafaranga abitswe yaturutse kuri ubu bwishyu niba atarakoreshwa.
reversal.loanGivenBack: Inguzanyo {{loan}}: {{principal}} y'ingenzi na {{interest}} y'inyungu byasubijwe; inguzanyo isigaranye {{outstanding}} y'ingenzi

receipt.notProof: Amagambo yasomwe ku ifoto y’inyemezabwishyu ni ibyo bavuga, si gihamya y’ubwishyu. Ntiyemeza cyangwa ngo yandike ubwishyu; ibyo bikorwa gusa n’ibimenyetso byizewe n’icyemezo cy’umuyobozi.

failure.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: Amafoto ya PNG na JPEG gusa ni yo asomwa. Genzura inyemezabwishyu n’amaso.

failure.PDF_UNREADABLE: Iyi PDF ntiyabashije gufungurwa. Reba inyandiko n'amaso.
failure.PDF_ENCRYPTED: Iyi PDF irinzwe n'ijambobanga, ntiyasomwe. Reba inyandiko n'amaso.
failure.PDF_TOO_MANY_PAGES: Iyi PDF ifite impapuro nyinshi cyane ku buryo itaba inyandiko y'ubwishyu, ntiyasomwe.

failure.PDF_TIMEOUT: Gusoma iyi PDF byafashe igihe kirekire. Ushobora kongera kugerageza.
failure.PDF_BUSY: Inyandiko nyinshi zirimo gusomwa ubu. Ushobora kongera kugerageza mu kanya.

receipt.noDiscrepancy: Nta tandukaniro n’ibyavuzwe ryabonetse. Ntibiba gihamya.

outcome.notAStatus: Ibyavuye mu kugenzura ibimenyetso bitandukanye n’imiterere y’ubwishyu. Kwemeza ntibyemeza cyangwa ngo byandike ubwishyu; abayobozi ni bo babikora.

reason.NO_TRUSTED_RECORD: Nta murongo w’inyandiko cyangwa icyemezo cya serivisi biraboneka
reason.AWAITING_CASH_CONFIRMATION: Hategerejwe ko umuyobozi yemeza amafaranga mu ntoki

outcome.strictRequired: Iyi sisitemu isaba icyemezo cyizewe mbere yo kwemeza ubwishyu.
outcome.blocked: Ibimenyetso bihabanye cyangwa byanze bibuza kwemeza ubu bwishyu.
outcome.cashTitle: Emeza ko amafaranga mu ntoki yakiriwe
outcome.cashExplain: Emeza gusa amafaranga wakiriye ubwawe. Ntushobora kwemeza ubwishyu bwawe, kandi byandikwa ku izina ryawe.
outcome.cashNeedsAnotherOfficer: Undi muyobozi agomba kwemeza aya mafaranga. Uwishyuye n’uwohereje ubwishyu ntibabishobora.

reconcile.attentionHelp: Ubwishyu bufunguye ibimenyetso byabwo bihabanye, byanze, nta byahuye cyangwa biratinze. Fungura kimwe urebe impamvu.
reconcile.importHelp: Andika umurongo uva ku nyandiko ya banki cyangwa ya mobile money. Uhuzwa n’ubwishyu hakurikijwe uburyo na nomero, ariko ntiwemeza cyangwa ngo wandike ubwishyu. Umuyobozi wandika umurongo ntashobora kwemeza ubwishyu uwemeza.

Kuyemeza byongeraho amafaranga yemejwe gusa: nta nyandiko y’imari ikorwa kandi nta mubare uhinduka. Undi muyobozi ufite ububasha ku mafaranga agomba kubyemeza.
reconcile.amountTooHigh: Andika amafaranga arenze zeru adasumba ayataremezwa.
reconcile.declineExplain: Nta kintu gihinduka: amafaranga akomeza kutemezwa kandi impamvu iranditswa.
reconcile.withdrawExplain: Nta kintu gihinduka kandi icyifuzo kirafungwa. Cyandikwa mu mateka.

receiptAnalysis.failed: Ibimenyetso by'ubwishyu washyizeho bigaragaza ko igikorwa cyananiranye. Nyamuneka ishyura neza kuri konti y'ikimina hanyuma ushyireho ibimenyetso bishya by'ubwishyu.

accounts.title: Aho abanyamuryango bishyura
accounts.description: Konti iki kimina gisaba abanyamuryango kwishyuraho. Inyandiko igaragaza indi konti ihagarikwa ngo isuzumwe n'umuyobozi.
accounts.label: Izina (si ngombwa)
accounts.deleteMessage: Iyi konti ntiyigeze ikoreshwa mu bwishyu cyangwa mu rupapuro rw'ubwishyu kandi izasibwa burundu.
accounts.deactivateMessage: Abanyamuryango ntibazongera kwerekwa iyi konti. Ubwishyu n'inyandiko zamaze gukorwa zigumana amateka yazo, bityo konti iragumaho, ntisibwe.

credit.title: Kwishyura arenze ayo ugomba
credit.hint: Ayo wishyura arenze ayo ugomba abikwa nk'amafaranga yawe abitswe. Si inyungu y'ikimina. Umuyobozi azayakoresha nyuma ku musanzu cyangwa ku nguzanyo.
credit.needsLoan: Hitamo inguzanyo iri kwishyurwa mbere y'igihe.
credit.officerDescription: Amafaranga abanyamuryango bishyuye arenze ayo bagombaga. Si inyungu kandi si amafaranga y'ikimina kugeza umuyobozi ayakoresheje.
credit.noTargets: Uyu munyamuryango nta kintu gifunguye ayo mafaranga yakoreshwaho.

withdraw.title: Gusubiza ubu bwishyu inyuma?
withdraw.explain: Nta muntu uratangira gusuzuma ubu bwishyu kandi nta kintu cyandikiwe. Buzashyirwa nk'ubwasubijwe inyuma nawe kandi nomero yabwo yakongera gukoreshwa. Inyandiko iguma mu mateka yawe.

summary.explain: Imisanzu iteganyijwe ni ibiteganyijwe, si amafaranga ahari. Amafaranga y’uruhererekane yerekanwa atandukanye n’umutungo usigara, kandi ibyo abakira bagisigaje ni umwenda, si umutungo w’abanyamuryango.
summary.availableAfter: Amafaranga ahari nyuma y’ibyo abakira bagomba
summary.rotatingCollectedHint: Byemejwe; ni byo shingiro ry’ibyo abakira bagomba
summary.reconciliationHint: Byanditswe nta kwemeza; ntibigomba kwishyurwa cyangwa gutangwa
summary.totalLiabilitiesHint: Ibyo bagomba ku mafaranga yemejwe hiyongereyeho uruhererekane rutaremezwa
summary.unclassifiedHint: Byishyuwe mbere y’uko uburyo bwandikwa; si ibisigara cyangwa umwenda kugeza bikemuwe
summary.unresolvedRotatingHint: Birabikirwa abakira; ntibyishyurwa kandi si umutungo w’abanyamuryango kugeza bihawe igihe
summary.unresolvedAlert: Amafaranga amwe ntashyizwe mu byiciro ({{unclassified}}) cyangwa azwi ko ari uruhererekane ariko igihe cyayo kitazwi ({{rotating}}). Ntashyirwa mu mutungo usigara cyangwa ku ukira, kandi ntiyishyurwa.

historicalTransactions.title: Ibikorwa by’amateka
historicalTransactions.description: Injiza amateka y’itariki ku yindi y’itsinda risanzwe ryo kuzigama ku myaka myinshi.
historicalTransactions.intro: Kwinjiza kuyobowe mu ntambwe enye: manura inyandikorugero, uzuze impapuro zombi, suzuma (nta kintu cyandikwa), hanyuma undi muyobozi abyemeze.

rules.sheets: Dosiye ifite impapuro ebyiri zonyine: Abanyamuryango n’Igenamiterere, n’Ibikorwa by’Amateka.
rules.noInvention: Nta kintu gihimbwa: ubwoko bw’ibikorwa butemewe, abanyamuryango batazwi n’amatariki mabi byanzwe umurongo ku wundi.
rules.loans: Inguzanyo n’amafaranga yatanzwe ku banyamuryango ntibyinjizwa nk’amateka: bikenera gahunda y’ubwishyu, imbonerahamwe n’uwahawe amafaranga bitaboneka muri urwo rutonde. Koresha kwimura inguzanyo z’amafaranga y’itangira.
rules.overlap: Amateka agomba gusozwa mbere y’inyandiko ya mbere ikora y’itsinda, kugira ngo nta kintu gihwanyirizwa kabiri.
rules.unresolved: Imisanzu yinjijwe ntishobora na rimwe kwishyurwa kandi ntihabwa ukira: igihe cyayo cy’umwimerere cy’uruhererekane ntikizwi.
rules.final: Kwandika ni ntakuka. Inyandiko zimaze kwandikwa ntizihindurwa cyangwa ngo zisibwe.

migrationReview.notice: Iki kimina cyinjije amateka mu buryo burenze bumwe mbere y'uko iri tegeko riboneka. Kwinjiza amateka byahagaze kugeza Perezida cyangwa Visi-Perezida akemuye isuzuma. Ibindi byose bikora nk'uko bisanzwe.
migrationReview.noticeAuthority: Iki kimina cyinjije amateka mu buryo burenze bumwe mbere y'uko iri tegeko riboneka. Kwinjiza amateka byahagaze kugeza ukemuye isuzuma.
migrationReview.resolveExplain: Vuga uburyo ari bwo bwemewe n'uko ikimina cyahujwe. Ibi ntibihindura imibare: banza ukosore amateka yabazwe kabiri unyuze mu buryo busanzwe bwo gukosora. Icyemezo kiranditswe.
migrationReview.cutover: Amateka kugeza ku itariki (itariki yo guhindura)
migrationReview.platformExplain: Ibi bimina ntibyemera kwinjiza amateka ndetse kugeza ushinzwe amafaranga akemuye isuzuma.

positions.title: Uko abanyamuryango bahagaze
positions.help: Igishoro kiyongera ku byo buri munyamuryango asiga mu kimina; inyungu igabanywa kimwe kuri buri mugabane; inkingi yo kuzunguruka yerekana ibyo ikimina kimubereyemo (byiza) cyangwa avansi itagira inyungu ari kwishyura (bibi).
positions.reconciliation: Igishoro, inyungu n'ukuzunguruka by'abanyamuryango bingana na {{expected}} RWF; amafaranga ahari, inguzanyo zatanzwe n'ishoramari ni {{actual}} RWF (itandukaniro {{difference}}). Inyungu yo kugabana: {{income}} RWF, {{perShare}} kuri buri mugabane.
positions.advanceNote: Wahawe {{amount}} RWF mbere yo kuyatanga. Si inguzanyo kandi nta nyungu: imisanzu yawe isigaye ni yo iyishyura.
positions.owedNote: Ikimina kikubereyemo {{amount}} RWF yo kuzunguruka: uzayahabwa ku gihe cyawe.

openingWorkbook.title: Kuzunguruka n'uko abanyamuryango bahagaze mbere yo kwimuka
openingWorkbook.help: Ifishi ya gatatu yo kwimuka, ku kimina cyari gisanzwe gikora. Yinjize nyuma y'ifishi y'abanyamuryango n'igishoro n'iy'inguzanyo.
openingWorkbook.step1: Urupapuro Scheme: uruziga ruriho (ukwezi kwa mbere, amezi, ibihabwa kuri buri mugabane, ikizunguruka kuri buri mugabane, uko imigabane ihabwa), amafaranga yo kuzunguruka ari kuri konti, n'inyungu itaragabanywa. Ku kimina kizigama gusa, siga ubusa imirongo y'uruziga.
openingWorkbook.step2: Urupapuro Turns: umurongo umwe ku munyamuryango n'ukwezi: imigabane ihabwa muri uko kwezi n'ibyo yamaze guhabwa.
openingWorkbook.step3: Urupapuro Members: amafaranga yazungurutse buri munyamuryango yishyuye mbere yo kwimuka, n'ayo ikimina kimubereyemo.
openingWorkbook.result: Abanyamuryango {{members}} bavuguruwe; ibyo ikimina kibereyemo abanyamuryango {{owed}} RWF; inyungu yo kugabana {{income}} RWF.
openingWorkbook.rotationResult: Kuzunguruka: hishyuwe {{paid}}, hatanzwe {{received}}, bityo {{expected}} RWF yagombye kuba kuri konti (itandukaniro {{difference}}).

revision.notice: Iyi dosiye yamaze kwinjizwa. Kongera kuyohereza ni ukuyikosora: verisiyo nshya isimbura iriho ubu, iyo ikaguma mu mateka ari hasi.
